test_path: (no dedicated route unit test). lib/notifications/__tests__/tokenFailures.test.ts covers resolveTokenFailure helper.

findings.failing_input: Supabase select on token_failures returns { error: { message: 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: invalid jwt: foo.bar.baz' } } — env-related error.
findings.expected: Sanitized via userFacingError so the JWT or service-role hint never reaches the browser.
findings.actual: Line 95: `{ error: error.message, ... }` — RAW Supabase error message leaked to the browser. Sibling routes (operator/jobs, dashboard-state, store-meta, manual-overrides) all use userFacingError() to redact. Same family as the CR-01 fix the apiErrors module was created to address. Information-disclosure on the GET error path.
findings.fix_sketch: Wrap: `{ error: userFacingError(error.message), ... }`. Also log raw to console.error so ops can see it server-side.
findings.regression_test_idea: Mock supabase to return error.message containing 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY'; assert response.error does NOT contain that substring.

findings.failing_input: Catch path (admin() throws because env vars missing).
findings.expected: Sanitized error per the operator-constraint convention.
findings.actual: Line 119 + 172: `e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)` — RAW error returned. admin() throws with literal 'missing SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY' — that text leaks to the browser. Same family as API-37.
findings.fix_sketch: Wrap with userFacingError(). Add console.error('/api/operator/token-failures', e.message) for ops.
findings.regression_test_idea: Unset SUPABASE_URL, GET the endpoint; assert response.error does not contain 'SUPABASE_URL' literal string.

findings.failing_input: Comment says '30-day window' but code says 7-day.
findings.actual: File-level docstring line 6: 'Includes 30-day window so resolved items stay visible'. Implementation line 66: `Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000` (7 days). Operator using the comment as spec sees a different number than the code. Per SPEC §Requirement 4 test-coverage gaps.
findings.fix_sketch: Update the docstring to say '7-day window' (assuming 7 is the intended value).
findings.regression_test_idea: Add a comment-vs-literal check OR add a test that pins the lookback constant.

findings.failing_input: admin() called multiple times in rapid succession (GET + POST overlap).
findings.actual: Creates a fresh client on every call. supabaseAdmin.ts (the shared module) explicitly uses a `let cached` pattern. This route duplicates the createClient logic — should use getSupabaseAdmin() from supabaseAdmin.ts for consistency and to inherit any future caching improvements.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace local admin() function with `import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabaseAdmin'`.
findings.regression_test_idea: After fix: assert createClient called only once across 3 sequential GET calls (cached).

uncertainty_notes: Provider/store validation is sound. Resolve action correctly delegated. The raw error leaks (API-37 + API-38) are real CR-01-family information-disclosure bugs that the apiErrors module was specifically designed to prevent.
test_coverage_gaps: GET Supabase error path: NOT covered (would have caught API-37).
POST success → resolveTokenFailure called with correct args: covered via tokenFailures.test.ts.
